taxonomy.label: Textureless Surface
taxonomy.desc: Featureless planar walls, doors, ceilings with low gradient variance (variance < 200).

taxonomy.label: Boundary Mixing / Bleed
taxonomy.desc: Depth bleeding across high-frequency foreground/background object contours.

taxonomy.label: Specular Reflection
taxonomy.desc: Non-Lambertian glares, mirrors, or glossy floor reflections with high HSV value and low saturation.

taxonomy.label: Thin Slender Structure
taxonomy.desc: Elongated geometries (chair legs, cords, poles) with bounding-box aspect ratio > 3.0.

taxonomy.label: Poor / Extreme Lighting
taxonomy.desc: Extreme underexposed shadow regions (brightness < 60) or overexposed glares (> 200).

taxonomy.label: Occlusion Boundary
taxonomy.desc: Sharp depth step discontinuities across occluding foreground edges.

taxonomy.label: Ambiguous / Multi-Cause
taxonomy.desc: Weak overall signal (score < 0.40) or competing hypotheses (score margin Delta < 0.10).
